purpose: Document first-party Takasaki parcel-map discovery, public request outcomes, schema/CRS, and bounded exact-point geometry review.
assessment: A first-party local public parcel source was verified. Takasaki City publishes a citywide parcel-number polygon Shapefile and links it from its official open-data and cadastral-map pages. The dataset is reference-only and not a legal boundary/survey source. A bounded exact-point test found native FUDEID 299414.
registryAssessment: Local registry/map custody is evidenced by Takasaki City's Asset Tax Division publication and city map service. This is source evidence only; it is not runtime integration or admission.
